content:
Let the top-left number of the \(2\times2\) block be \(n\).  
The four numbers are

\[
n,\ n+1,\ n+7,\ n+8.
\]

A 3-square L-shape is any three of these, so its sum is one of

\[
3n+8,\quad 3n+9,\quad 3n+15,\quad 3n+16.
\]

Set these equal to \(2015\):

\[
\begin{aligned}
3n+8&=2015 \implies n=669,\\
3n+9&=2015 \implies \text{not integer},\\
3n+15&=2015 \implies \text{not integer},\\
3n+16&=2015 \implies \text{not integer}.
\end{aligned}
\]

Thus the L-shape omits \(n+8\), so the three numbers are

\[
669,\ 670,\ 676.
\]

The largest is

\[
\boxed{676}.
\]
